connector.name: ClickHouse
connector.registryDescription: Official ClickHouse MCP server for querying and exploring ClickHouse clusters and chDB.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-clickhouse. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the clickhouse account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PORT
env.description: ClickHouse HTTP(S) port. Defaults to 8443 when CLICKHOUSE_SECURE=true, 8123 otherwise

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_SECURE
env.description: Use HTTPS to connect to ClickHouse

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_ROLE
env.description: ClickHouse role to activate for the session

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_WRITE_ACCESS
env.description: Allow write operations (DDL and DML). Queries run read-only by default

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_DROP
env.description: Allow destructive operations (DROP, TRUNCATE) when write access is also enabled
